bio.text: Larinda C. Hooks is the Assembly Member for District 35, which includes Corona, LeFrak City, East Elmhurst and Rego Park.

Her official biography describes her as a lifelong community organizer who served as president of the Ericsson Street Block Association and later as president of the executive board of the East Elmhurst-Corona Civic Association.
She also worked at the East Harlem Council for Community Improvement and served as vice chairperson of the board of Elmcor Youth & Adult Activities, Inc.
